entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Shelter the Young

*It turns at the cry beside it, bringing its whole body between the danger and the one it protects.*

After a visible enemy ends voluntary movement adjacent to a willing ally within 3 squares, move up to 2 squares, ending adjacent to that ally. Pay normal terrain costs and provoke normally. This movement grants no attack or automatic protection; its body obstructs only the squares it actually occupies. Movement granted by a free attack cannot trigger it.

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 1; an explicit creature trait, not a bonus from size.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Deep hoof prints cross a fence without breaking it.

**Purpose:** Lead the herd away from danger.

**Tactics and retreat:** Drive one pursuer back, then run toward open ground.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Do not corner the herd; give its leader an escape route.

**Habitat:** Wilderness · **Communication:** None

**Loot:** A naturally shed antler may serve as a story clue or craft ingredient at the DA’s discretion.

**Summoning:** Animal 3 — [player reference](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/summons/great-stag.md).
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-great-stag


**Category:** Animal · **Role:** Line breaker · **CV:** 15

**Difficulty rationale:** An agile or elusive body warrants attack Banes. Ordinary attack difficulty; riders and positioning carry the threat.

**Reference damage:** 3/4/6

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.3

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.2 → 1.3: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=4.404, O=3.162. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [driving blow](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/driving-blow.md), [great stag guard the herd](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/great-stag-guard-the-herd.md), [Shelter the Young](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/shelter-the-young.md).

# Driving Blow

*The blow lands with enough force to send its victim stumbling backward.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-driving-blow


**Action:** Main Action

Use the printed attack. Standard pushes the target 1 square; Strong pushes it 2. Apply Stability before moving. This is a rider, not a separate attack or Force action.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.
